notes.title: ENDLESS TENNIS Update
notes.notes:
[h1]What if... Tennis... was Endless?[/h1]
We are celebrating our participation in the Six One Indie Spring Showcase with an exciting new demo update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44927597/010569569c17a342f181f94ec168401e7a3b0d57.gif[/img]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Endless Mode - complete the demo and keep on looping
[*]Tails - each loop will grant you an additional limb slot!
[*]New passive tattoos that trigger limb slots for insane combos
[*]Tattoo Viewbar - easily reference your tattoos in the shop, and stack multiple tattoos
[*]Balance adjustments to Critters, Shells, and more
[/list]

Thanks for checking out TORSO TENNIS!
- Michael Mato

Visit my website for monthly updates or to find me elsewhere on the internet:
[url=https://www.toomuchtomato.com/]https://www.toomuchtomato.com/[/url]

notes.title: The Spooky Update!
notes.notes:
The Spooky Update includes a frighteningly large amount of new content in the Demo. New Limbs, New Bosses, and new Offensive Play options with RIPs. Tattoos are now FREE at the end of each week and you also get the option to tear limbs off of opponents that you defeat!

This is both a huge content and QoL update: Save mid-run and return to the game later. Leave feedback and ideas on the demo. Take ANY LIMB from a defeated opponent and use it to start a new run.

New Limbs: Skull, Bone, Broom, and Tentacle allow you to leave RIPs on the court - literal holes in the fabric of reality. These RIPs serve as weak points where you can direct tennis balls to INSTA-SCORE on your opponent. New Boss Jim Coach will challenge you to hit weak points and barrage you with critter attacks. To top it all off, sport the new fashionable Rib Cage TORSO while you make your way through the demo!

Tune in to the TORSO TENNIS development co-working streams on Twitch to give feedback and join the community: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/toomuchtomato]https://www.twitch.tv/toomuchtomato[/url]

notes.title: We're launching our Demo for Endless Replayability Fest
notes.notes:
[h2]It's time![/h2]
We just launched our demo for Steam's Endless Replayability Fest! I'll be live on Twitch throughout the week working on updates and changes to keep yall on your toes. I'm excited to get everyone's feedback and incorporate it into the final game!

[h2]Live Service... Demo?[/h2]
I'm going to be continuously updating this demo until I'm ready to launch the full game! The demo as it stands right now lets you get the feel of a few weeks into of a typical TORSO TENNIS run. It has all of the content in the main game, and I plan on injecting every new piece of content into the demo as a live testing ground. I've had so much fun playtesting this game in my local developer group, and I hope you also enjoy being a part of the development process!

[h2]The story so far[/h2]
TORSO TENNIS was initially developed in one week as a part of Global Game Jam. The hectic tennis madness was super fun and I've been hard at work refining it over the last few months. This demo is the result of 2-3 months of work on the project and I hope you all enjoy it! Since it's the first playable demo of the game, there are bound to be some bugs and fun ways to break the game. I hope you find them and enjoy them. I'll be writing patch notes over in the Community Tab throughout the week, so stay tuned for that if you'd like to know what changes get made throughout the week.

Thanks so much for your support!
Michael
